versos.grego: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλο σημεῖον ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ μέγα καὶ θαυμαστόν, ἀγγέλους ἑπτὰ ἔχοντας πληγὰς ἑπτὰ τὰς ἐσχάτας, ὅτι ἐν αὐταῖς ἐτελέσθη ὁ θυμὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
controles.kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
controles.livre: E eu vi outro grande e admirável sinal no céu: sete anjos, que tinham as sete últimas pragas; porque nelas a ira de Deus se torna completa.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἶδον ὡς θάλασσαν ὑαλίνην μεμιγμένην πυρί, καὶ τοὺς νικῶντας ἐκ τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐκ τῆς εἰκόνος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν ὑαλίνην, ἔχοντας κιθάρας τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
controles.kjv: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
controles.livre: E eu vi como um mar de vidro misturado como fogo; e aos que venceram a besta, a sua imagem, e sua marca, e o número de seu nome, os quais estavam de pé junto ao mar de vidro, e tinham harpas de Deus;

versos.grego: καὶ ᾄδουσιν τὴν ᾠδὴν Μωϋσέως τοῦ δούλου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν ᾠδὴν τοῦ Ἀρνίου, λέγοντες Μεγάλα καὶ θαυμαστὰ τὰ ἔργα σου, Κύριε ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ· δίκαιαι καὶ ἀληθιναὶ αἱ ὁδοί σου, ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν·

controles.web: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying,  “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
controles.kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
controles.livre: E cantavam o cântico de Moisés, o servo de Deus, e o cântico do Cordeiro, dizendo: Grandes e maravilhosas são tuas obras, ó Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso! Teus caminhos são justos e verdadeiros, ó Rei das nações!

versos.grego: τίς οὐ μὴ φοβηθῇ, Κύριε, καὶ δοξάσει τὸ ὄνομά σου; ὅτι μόνος ὅσιος, ὅτι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου, ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐφανερώθησαν.

controles.web: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
controles.kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
controles.livre: Quem não te temeria, ó Senhor, e não glorificaria o teu nome? Porque só tu és santo; porque todas as nações virão, e adorarão diante de ti, porque teus juízos foram manifestos!

versos.grego: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἠνοίγη ὁ ναὸς τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ,

controles.web: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
controles.kjv: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
controles.livre: E depois disto eu olhei, e eis que o templo do tabernáculo do testemunho foi aberto no céu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ ἑπτὰ ἄγγελοι οἱ ἔχοντες τὰς ἑπτὰ πληγὰς ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ, ἐνδεδυμένοι λίνον καθαρὸν λαμπρὸν καὶ περιεζωσμένοι περὶ τὰ στήθη ζώνας χρυσᾶς.

controles.web: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.
controles.kjv: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
controles.livre: E os sete anjos, que tinham as sete pragas, saíram do templo, vestidos de linho puro e brilhante, e cingidos com cintos de ouro ao redor dos peitos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἓν ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων ἔδωκεν τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλοις ἑπτὰ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

controles.web: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
controles.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
controles.livre: E um dos quatro animais deu aos sete anjos sete taças de ouro, cheias da ira de Deus, aquele que vive para todo o sempre.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγεμίσθη ὁ ναὸς καπνοῦ ἐκ τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἄχρι τελεσθῶσιν αἱ ἑπτὰ πληγαὶ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων.

controles.web: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
controles.kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
controles.livre: E o templo se encheu com a fumaça da glória de Deus, e do seu poder; e ninguém podia entrar no templo, enquanto as sete pragas dos sete anjos não estivessem completas.
